en-GB.unit_description_archer: Ranged ground units able to move and attack in the same turn. Critical hit when stationary.
en-GB.unit_description_ballista: Ranged ground-to-air unit, unable to move and attack in the same turn. Critical hit at min range.
en-GB.unit_description_balloon: Aircraft able to transport footsoldiers and Dog units.
en-GB.unit_description_barracks: Used to recruit new ground units. Can also reinforce injured units.
en-GB.unit_description_city: Each village provides an income of 100 gold per turn, and can reinforce injured units.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_caesar: He is Queen Mercia's dog, a Cherrystone general, and a very, very good boy.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_darkmercia: The Queen of Cherrystone's cruel and merciless counterpoint.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_elodie: A powerful spirit, dedicated to guarding the weapon that destroyed her nation.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_emeric: This learned and powerful mage is the trusted advisor of the rulers of Cherrystone.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_greenfinger: This wise chieftain of the Floran Tribes has power over plants, and puts it to good use in battle.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_koji: The Prince of Heavensong, and a child prodigy. Rides into battle on Tenko, his finest creation.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_mercia: The heroic queen of Cherrystone. Fights for her people with the mighty Cherryblade.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_mercival: The noble King of Cherrystone. A just and wise ruler.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_nuru: This visitor to the lands of the Floran tribes is a strong, clever and spirited hunter.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_ragna: Felheim's patchwork general, built to sow death and destruction.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_ryota: Heavensong's Grand Marshal. A chivalrous, strategic and dexterous warrior.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_sedge: A capable but vicious Floran general who cuts a shadowy figure.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_sigrid: The High Vampire of Western Felheim. She is ancient, smart and savage.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_tenri: The graceful Empress of Heavensong. Uses her fans to sculpt the wind.
en-GB.unit_description_commander_valder: The ruler of the Felheim Legion. Uses the Fell Gauntlet to command the undead.
en-GB.unit_description_crystal: Allied units within the crystal's aura enjoy increased defence. The crystal's health depletes over time.
en-GB.unit_description_dog: A quick unit. Critical hit when another dog unit is adjacent to the target.
en-GB.unit_description_dragon: Incredibly powerful air-to-ground unit. Critical hit when target is standing on a road.
en-GB.unit_description_drone: Inflicts damage over a small radius upon detonation. Will explode if attacked.
en-GB.unit_description_gate: Can be destroyed to open the way through.
en-GB.unit_description_giant: An immensely powerful unit. Critical hit when at or below 40% health.
en-GB.unit_description_harpoonship: Ranged water unit, able to attack air and sea. Critical hit when in reef.
en-GB.unit_description_harpy: Immensely mobile units, useful for crossing enemy lines. Critical hit when above a mountain.
en-GB.unit_description_hq: Must be defended at all costs.
en-GB.unit_description_knight: Powerful, mobile ground unit. Critical hit when it attacks from a location six spaces away from where it starts.
en-GB.unit_description_mage: A powerful unit built to combat air threats. Critical hit when defence is 3 or above. Able to heal allied targets by 20%.
en-GB.unit_description_merman: Amphibious infantry unit that can capture structures. Critical hit when in rivers or sea.
en-GB.unit_description_port: Used to recruit new water units. Can also reinforce injured units.
en-GB.unit_description_soldier: Basic infantry, useful for capturing structures. Critical hit when adjacent to its commander.
en-GB.unit_description_spearman: Slower, more powerful infantry. Critical hit when adjacent to another spearman.
en-GB.unit_description_tower: Used to recruit new air units. Can also reinforce injured units.
en-GB.unit_description_travelboat: Boats able to transport all ground units across water.
en-GB.unit_description_trebuchet: Powerful long-range unit, unable to move and attack in the same turn. Critical hit at max range.
en-GB.unit_description_turtle: Powerful naval unit, built to conquer the water. Critical hit when in deep sea.
en-GB.unit_description_villager: Simple peasants. They're not equipped to fight, and are vulnerable to just about everything.
en-GB.unit_description_vine: Impassable by non-allied units. Their health depletes over time.
en-GB.unit_description_wagon: Capable of quickly transporting units that would otherwise travel by foot.
en-GB.unit_description_warship: An immensely powerful long range unit. Critical hit when on beach.
en-GB.unit_description_water_city: Each water village provides an income of 100 gold per turn, and can reinforce injured units.
en-GB.unit_description_witch: Air-to-air unit. Critical hit when target is not adjacent to its own allied witch. Hex deals 10% damage to all unit types.
